description: Fixed geographic regions for the regional RZMC DA-OL observing-system transition diagnostic. Boxes are simple lat/lon bounds intersected with the static valid_land mask and with a fixed all-month finite OL/DA sample, so regional membership is constant across all 288 months.
provenance: Region bounds were drawn by eye from the Figure 16 DA-OL RZMC trend panel and rounded to whole degrees; they are NOT defined from significant-trend tiles and there is no algorithm or external source behind the exact values. The analysis they support is a timing decomposition of the Figure 16 result - when did the established regional trends appear - rather than an independent test that these regions are special.
